sources.use: Route framing by arches, road markings, the sun and restrained trim in the original Dust II. The subsequent Source 1 reconstruction is a different edition.
Rani-ki-Vav, Patan. The brief synthesis describes the stepped descent, four pavilions, tank and well shaft. These informed the cadence of the new western sequence.
Group of Monuments at Hampi. The brief synthesis records Vitthala’s bazaar, tank, wells, hydraulic network and pillared market streets. These informed the exchange’s repeating civic bays.

Dholavira. The brief synthesis and criterion iv describe two seasonal streams, reservoirs and water conservation in an arid site. These informed the legibility of collection, storage and distribution.
